properties.description: Persistent URI identifying this source carrier record.
Fixed type token identifying this record as a source carrier (maps to crm:E31_Document).
Getty AAT URI for the physical carrier type, e.g.: paper document (300264612), photograph (300046300), architectural drawing (300034787), photographic negative (300127173), bound volume (300028051).
Title or descriptive label of the physical carrier (crm:P102_has_title).
URI(s) of the person(s) or organisation(s) who created the carrier (dct:creator).
Date or date range of creation (free text or ISO 8601, e.g. "1742", "1890–1910").
BCP 47 language code of the textual content, if applicable (e.g. "it", "en", "mt").
Name or URI of the institution holding the physical carrier (crm:P50_has_current_keeper). Use a URI where available (e.g. ISNI, Wikidata).
Archival reference code, call number or shelfmark assigned by the holding institution (crm:P1_is_identified_by), e.g. "ASTo, Corte, Venaria Reale, mazzo 12, n. 3".
Collection or archival series to which this carrier belongs (dct:isPartOf).
Physical dimensions, substrate and format description, e.g. "44 × 62 cm, ink on paper, rolled".
Overall physical condition of the carrier, e.g. "good", "fragile — foxing on margins", "damaged — lower third missing" (crm:P44_has_condition).
Access rights or licence URI or label, e.g. a Creative Commons URI or "Restricted — archive access only" (dct:rights).
URI of the heritage-object, place or site that this carrier documents (crm:P70_documents). Optional — use when the primary subject is known.
